defs.def: that used to exist in earlier times 以前的

ex.s: Interlibrary loan is not available to former students, guest borrowers or fee-card holders.
ex.t: 馆际互借不对往届生、访客借阅者或付费卡持有者开放。

ex.s: Her former employer was out of business.
Maurice Ashley was kind and smart, a former graduate returning to teach, and this  48  was no game for him: he meant business.
ex.t: 莫里斯·阿什利善良而聪明，是回校执教的往届毕业生，对他来说这___48___绝非儿戏：他是认真的。

ex.s: Through the years, I’d run into former students who would provide    51    on old classmates.
ex.t: 这些年来，我偶遇了一些以前的学生，他们会提供关于老同学的___51___信息。

ex.s: Born in a small village in Southwest China, she decided not to follow many of her former classmates to the city after getting her degree at university.
ex.t: 她出生在中国西南的一个小村庄，获得大学学位后，她决定不像许多以前的同学那样去城市。

defs.def: that used to have a particular position or status in the past 昔日的；前

ex.s: Last week, in a public debate in San Francisco, a software program called Project Debater beat its human opponents, including Noa Ovadia, Israel’s former national debating champion.
ex.t: 上周，在旧金山的一场公开辩论中，一个名为"辩论者项目"的软件程序击败了它的人类对手，包括以色列前全国辩论冠军诺亚·奥瓦迪亚。

ex.s: Mike Sullivan, a former construction worker, took up woodworking after he and his wife, Judy, retired.
ex.t: 迈克·沙利文是一名前建筑工人，他和妻子朱迪退休后开始从事木工。

ex.s: Clues: destroyed years ago; studying old photos; made the new palace like the old one Guess: The former palace means “the palace that ”.
ex.t: 线索：多年前被毁；研究老照片；把新宫殿建得像旧的一样。猜测：前宫殿的意思是"……的宫殿"。

ex.s: “Grizzly bears are re-occupying large areas of their former range,” says bear biologist Chris Servheen.
ex.t: “灰熊正在重新占据它们昔日活动范围的大片区域，”熊类生物学家克里斯·瑟夫希恩说。

ex.s: By the early 1970s, after centuries of cruel and continuous hunting by settlers, 600 to 800 grizzlies remained on a mere 2 percent of their former range in the Northern Rockies.
ex.t: 到20世纪70年代初，在定居者几个世纪残酷而持续的捕猎之后，在北部落基山脉，仅剩600到800只灰熊栖息在它们昔日活动范围的区区2%的土地上。

ex.s: Today I'm joined by a former student of our school, Lisa Osborne.
ex.t: 今天和我一起的是我们学校的一位往届学生，丽莎·奥斯本。

ex.s: The Palace Museum was built in it in 1925 and in 1987 the former imperial residence was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
ex.t: 故宫博物院于1925年建成，1987年这个前皇家住所被列为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

ex.s: By studying old photos of the former palace, they have made the new one look exactly like the old one.
ex.t: 通过研究旧宫殿的老照片，他们把新的建得和旧的一模一样。

ex.s: In the former case you may be able to read a chapter.
ex.t: 在前一种情况下，你可能能读一章。

ex.s: Ideally, you’ll end up putting more weight on the latter than the former.
ex.t: 也许你的家庭不会完全转变，但你可能对自己的一些私人空间有一定的控制权，可以进行你想要的改变。

defs.def: the first of two things or people mentioned （两者中的）前者

chunks.en: former range / palace / students / case / graduate / classmates / construction
chunks.cn: 前者范围 / 前者住在王宫里的人 / 前者学生 / 前者案例 / 前者大学毕业生 / 前者同学 / 前者建筑
